plan.question: Can multiple already-held-out photographs of a lesion add useful information to fixed S83 predictions?
plan.rule: Equal probability mean over every available image of each lesion within the original held-out cohort; singleton unchanged
plan.input_contract: Known lesion grouping and all available distinct held-out images per lesion, not single-image input
plan.grouping_uses: lesion_id only; never labels, correctness or confidence
plan.primary: ALL1118 lesions, one decision per lesion; equal mean versus first lexicographic image-ID single-view control
plan.secondary: ALL1503 images; broadcast pooled case prediction versus original saved S83 single-image prediction
plan.reporting: Retrospective multi-image lesion-level assessment of saved S83 predictions; not a new untouched test
plan.preserve: Original S83 single-image87.558217%/0.807031 result and all original files unchanged
plan.gate: >=0.005 accuracy gain, nondecreasing macro-F1/melanoma/akiec recall for both matched endpoints; >=8 net correct gains for image endpoint
plan.probability_arithmetic: CPU float64 on previously saved FP32 six-model probabilities; no new model logits
plan.limitation: Lesion-level and image-level denominators/class mixes differ; a higher case score alone is not a model improvement
